prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website homepage first-viewport design comp, 1536×1024 landscape
Primary request: Design an unmistakably usable public portfolio homepage for a developer focused on financial tools, in an INSTRUMENT DISPLAY direction inspired by true seven-segment clocks, price totems, and scoreboards. The primary visitor action is exploring the developer's work.
Scene/backdrop: A flat, straight-on screenshot of a real responsive desktop webpage inside the 1536×1024 canvas. No browser chrome, no device mockup, no perspective. Show the complete first viewport plus enough of the second fold at the bottom to prove that writing/articles and contact content can live here.
Subject: A refined public developer portfolio homepage. Top navigation contains the exact labels “HOME”, “PROJECTS”, “ABOUT”, “RESUME”, “CONTACTS”, “BLOG”. The hero contains the exact headline “Developer focused on financial tools.”, the exact supporting line “I build and write about technology, development, and finance.”, and the exact action “Explore my work”. Beneath or alongside the hero, include a synchronized GitHub contribution-style cell bank labeled exactly “GitHub activity” and a larger featured financial-product instrument labeled exactly “Financial app project”. Include subtle continuation cues for articles and contact near the lower fold, without introducing any additional brand, project, or factual claims.
Style/medium: Editorial-grade web UI mockup; restrained digital-instrument visual language; Swiss grid discipline fused with genuine seven-segment display hardware. Use true geometric seven-segment digits/letterforms only for the monumental focal thesis or abstract display readout, with visible unlit segment masks and fixed slots. Use clean modern sans-serif type for all navigation, body copy, labels, and buttons. Dense but breathable, purposeful alignment, production-realistic spacing, accessible hierarchy, mature and premium rather than playful.
Composition/framing: Header navigation across the top as compact physical mode buttons, with HOME visibly selected. Monumental segmented thesis/instrument dominates the hero as one unmistakable focal move, balanced by crisp readable headline and support text. Place the “Explore my work” control prominently. Below, a modular two-column proof deck: synchronized GitHub cell bank and featured financial app as the primary instrument, with the financial app module visually dominant. Preserve clear click targets and normal website conventions. At the bottom edge, reveal a restrained slice of the next section suggesting articles and contact.
Lighting/mood: Matte, low-glare instrument glass with precise internal illumination; restrained, confident, technical, quietly financial. Minimal glow confined inside lit segments; no atmospheric neon.
Color palette: matte near-black #090B0D background, LED red #F04438, amber #F5A524, scoreboard green #44C553, ghost cells #343A40, with restrained warm-white readable body text for accessibility.
Materials/textures: matte instrument glass, thin dark metal bezels, lit and unlit segment masks, ghost contribution cells, fine divider rules, subtle tactile mode buttons.
Text (verbatim): “HOME”; “PROJECTS”; “ABOUT”; “RESUME”; “CONTACTS”; “BLOG”; “Developer focused on financial tools.”; “I build and write about technology, development, and finance.”; “Explore my work”; “GitHub activity”; “Financial app project”
Constraints: Render every required text string exactly once and legibly. The page must look buildable, navigable, and clearly like a portfolio website rather than a poster. Keep body copy and controls in readable sans-serif typography. Use fixed display slots; segments change state rather than implying sliding animation. GitHub cell bank should evoke contribution activity without displaying invented counts. The featured financial app should look like an interface preview without any app name, metric, ticker, currency amount, performance claim, or fabricated data. Leave enough visible second fold to suggest ongoing articles and contact.
Avoid: invented metrics, numerical values, dates, prices, stock tickers, company names, clients, testimonials, app names, employers, awards, biography details, social handles, performance claims, generic dashboard overload, arcade-game UI, casino styling, neon cyberpunk glow, bloom, holograms, purple-blue gradients, fake terminal aesthetics, making all prose segmented, distorted text, illegible microcopy, poster composition, browser chrome, device frames, perspective mockups, photographs, people, logos, watermarks.
